newsitem.title: ITALY: San Paolo cap gain 20 bln lire on BNC deal.
newsitem.headline: San Paolo cap gain 20 bln lire on BNC deal.

text.p: Italian banking group San Paolo di Torino said on Thursday it would realise a capital gain of 20 billion lire on the previously announced sale of a 70 percent stake in BNC Assicurazioni to German insurance group HDI.
San Paolo said in a statement that HDI will pay 250 billion lire for the 70 percent stake, with San Paolo retaining the remaining 30 percent.

It added that 50 percent of the price will be paid on the transfer of the shareholding, forecast for July, while the remaining 50 percent will be paid on December 31, 1997 after a process of due diligence.
In a further move, HDI will take a one percent stake in San Paolo, but sources said HDI would not become part of the group of core shareholders in the bank's privatisation process.
